notes_for_editor: The name Lookout appears only on Dunigan's list. Mapcarta, which draws on OpenStreetMap, types the feature only as a tower, so it may not be a fire lookout (possibly a communications or other tower). Needs a check of the local tower and its use. Elevation units are not stated on the list; 36 is read as feet, matching the record's 11.0 m. A 2006 Savannah Morning News article on fading fire towers returned 403 and was not read; its search snippet mentioned a fire tower near Statesboro, not this one. Current status unknown.
